description: This PHP class defines the model for handling Node Resource Categories within the Goteo project. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, saving, and validating resource category data, as well as handling localization and database interactions.

classes.name: NodeResourceCategory
classes.description: Model class representing a node resource category with database interactions, localization, and validation logic.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields that are language-dependent, currently only 'name'.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a node resource category by its ID, including localization joins.

methods.name: getIdBySlug
methods.description: Fetches the ID of a node resource category based on its slug.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a list of node resource categories, supporting filters, pagination, and localization.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon image instance associated with the category.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the current category instance to the database.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the category data, primarily checking for empty 'name'.
